FROM (
    SELECT airline_name,
           title,
           author,
           flight_date

    GROUP BY airline_name,
             title,
             author,
             flight_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) d;

%jdbc(hive)

CREATE TABLE mas_airasia_reviews_clean AS
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY airline_name,
                            title,
                            author,
                            flight_date
               ORDER BY flight_date
           ) AS rn
    FROM mas_airasia_reviews
) t
WHERE rn = 1;

%jdbc(hive)

SELECT airline_name,
       title,
       author,
       flight_date,
       COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM mas_airasia_reviews_clean
GROUP BY airline_name,
         title,
         author,
         flight_date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

%jdbc(hive)

-- Check the number of reviews available for each airline after cleaning.

       COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM mas_airasia_reviews_clean

from textblob import TextBlob
from pyspark.sql.functions import udf
from pyspark.sql.types import StringType


def get_sentiment(text):
    score = TextBlob(text).sentiment.polarity
    
    if score > 0:
        return "Positive"
    elif score < 0:
        return "Negative"
    else:
        return "Neutral"


sentiment_udf = udf(get_sentiment, StringType())


df_sentiment = df.withColumn(
    "sentiment",
    sentiment_udf(df.content)
)

df_sentiment.show(10)
